blockingFindings.title: Required post-hook failures are not asserted to fail the caller
blockingFindings.rationale: An implementation could still treat required post-hook failures as successful lifecycle results while attaching outcome metadata, and these tests would not catch it.
blockingFindings.issue: R3 requires any required hook business failure to produce a typed caller failure and not be converted into ok:true, warning-only, or follow-up-only success. The business-failure matrix in R3 only exercises required pre-hooks. The only required post-hook failure test, R2, asserts outcome fields but never asserts result.ok is false or that the caller received the typed failure.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local assertion or case for a required post-hook business failure that verifies result.ok is false and the typed required failure is exposed to the caller.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation could still treat required post-hook failures as successful lifecycle results while attaching outcome metadata, and these tests would not catch it.

blockingFindings.title: Integrity hard failures are only tested for advisory policy
blockingFindings.rationale: A regression that only normalizes required-policy integrity failures, or otherwise handles required-policy integrity differently from advisory, would pass the current tests despite violating R5.
blockingFindings.issue: R5 says import failure, invalid register(api), invalid FlowCommandHook inheritance, missing snapshot module, and snapshot metadata mismatch remain hard failures regardless of hook policy. The integrityCases table only uses failurePolicy: "advisory" for these cases.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Exercise the same integrity hard-failure cases with failurePolicy: "required" as well, or parameterize the existing cases over both policies.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A regression that only normalizes required-policy integrity failures, or otherwise handles required-policy integrity differently from advisory, would pass the current tests despite violating R5.
